<!-- Introduction -->
::: {.intro-section}
Nice to meet you, I am Youngjun Park.
I am an urban researcher and architect, as well as a co-founder and CTO of **ar-ge inc.**, where I am developing Agentic AI-based architectural and urban design solutions.

My work follows four threads:<br>
1) **Research** that explores the city through behavioral data,<br>
2) **Design** that builds places for the public,<br>
3) **Engineering** that develops AI agent solutions,<br>
4) And **education** that teaches urban design and urban data analysis.

These four domains, speaking different languages, converge on a single question.<br>
**"How can we design evidence-based and accountable cities?"**
:::
